sentences.ar: ماف طلع من السجن وصار الكل يحبه.
sentences.en: Muff came out of prison and everyone loved him.
Tom became the town’s hero by day.
But at night he dreamed of Joe.
Every sound in the house frightened him.

sentences.ar: هَك كمان صار ينام وعينه مفتوحة.
sentences.en: Huck too began sleeping with one eye open.

sentences.ar: جو كان لسا برا وما حدا لقاه.
sentences.en: Joe was still out there and nobody had found him.
